# MatterDraft Studio

> MatterDraft is being developed as a local-first desktop workspace for preparing and organising legal documents, from source files to a reviewed, indexed document bundle.

Website: https://matterdraft.legal/

Status: In development for Windows and macOS.

## Product scope

- The product is in development. Release timing has not been announced; illustrated features are intended workflows, not evidence of a released production feature.
- Website demonstrations use fictional documents and sample data. They do not process or upload a real legal matter.
- The website does not offer checkout, process purchases or create customer accounts.
- Local-first describes local document workflows. Separately offered sharing or other connected features may require a network connection and their own disclosure.
- OCR output is editable recognised text; it is not a promise of generative legal drafting or error-free recognition.
- Electronic signature placement is distinct from digital certification. Court acceptance and legal validity require separate review.
- Users must review document content, ordering, page ranges, indexes, bookmarks and other outputs before use or filing.

## Intended workflows

### Import and organise

Bring PDF, Word and image source material into matter workflows. Organise documents into categories and parts, work across matter tabs, and choose the order of included documents.

### Recognise text and prepare documents

Intended OCR workflows turn scanned content into editable text for review. Structured templates use supplied fields to prepare documents; the website examples do not generate legal arguments.

### Edit and manage pages

Intended document tools cover merging, splitting, extracting, replacing, reordering, cropping, rotating, deleting and inserting pages.

### Collate, paginate and index

Arrange documents within parts and rebuild a coordinated bundle, page numbering and index. Review updated page ranges after a change to the source order.

### Create and edit bookmarks

Generate bookmarks from the document structure and review them alongside manual bookmark labels, page references and hierarchy.

### Plan document-aware volumes

Plan volumes around an approximate 300-page target while considering document boundaries. The target is not an absolute limit; an oversized individual document needs separate review.

### Check and export

Review validation findings before export. Intended output workflows include PDF and other supported document or archive formats; support depends on the relevant feature and release.

### Apply document controls

Intended tools include password protection, redaction, electronic signature placement, watermarks and timestamps. Users remain responsible for checking the resulting documents and applicable requirements.

## Availability

MatterDraft Studio is in development. Release timing has not been announced. The website previews early access registration, but does not currently accept signups or provide a purchase flow. Early access signups are offered six months free after launch.

## Policies

The website policy pages are review drafts awaiting business details and adoption. They are excluded from the sitemap and this content export.
